regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Keep hard /g/ clear in connected phrases
lessons.objective: Carry French /g/ through words and short phrases in a station meeting, including g and gu spellings.
lessons.focus: Compare gare, garage, guide, and guitare. Keep /g/ clear at the start of each word and in bagage, without treating the written u in guide or guitare as a separate vowel.

words.fr: Le guide attend devant la gare.
words.en: The guide is waiting in front of the station.

words.fr: Ma guitare est dans mon bagage.
words.en: My guitar is in my luggage.

words.fr: Le garage est près de la gare.
words.en: The garage is near the station.
We are going to save time.

reader.fr: Le guide m'attend devant la gare avec mon bagage.
reader.en: The guide is waiting for me in front of the station with my luggage.

reader.fr: Je lui dis que ma guitare est dans le bagage.
reader.en: I tell him that my guitar is in the luggage.

reader.fr: Sa voiture est dans un garage près de la gare.
reader.en: His car is in a garage near the station.

reader.fr: En partant tout de suite, nous allons gagner du temps.
reader.en: By leaving right away, we are going to save time.

speaking.scene: Meeting a guide at a train station
speaking.opening: Bonjour, ma guitare est dans mon bagage.
goals: Confirm where the guide is waiting.
Ask whether the garage is near the station.
speaking.closure: Merci, nous allons gagner du temps.

see.prompt: Locate the hard /g/ sound in gare, garage, guide, guitare, bagage, and gagner.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for guide before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for gare or garage in the recorded sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The garage is near the station.'
type.answerRef: Le garage est près de la gare.

say.prompt: Tell the guide that your guitar is in your luggage.
say.answerRef: Ma guitare est dans mon bagage.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the guide, station, and your guitar.

lessons.title: Use French /ʁ/ in a city walk
lessons.objective: Recognize and produce a reference French /ʁ/ at the start and within useful direction words.
lessons.focus: Listen to a chosen French speaker in rue, rouge, regarder, arrêt, carte, and parc. Keep one consistent /ʁ/ model across the short directions; it is different from English r.

words.fr: Le parc est au bout de cette rue.
words.en: The park is at the end of this street.

words.fr: L'arrêt est près du feu rouge.
words.en: The stop is near the red traffic light.

words.fr: Je prends la rue à droite.
words.en: I take the street on the right.

reader.fr: Je regarde une carte pour trouver le parc.
reader.en: I look at a map to find the park.

reader.fr: Le parc est dans la rue à droite.
reader.en: The park is on the street to the right.

reader.fr: Je passe près d'un feu rouge et de l'arrêt.
reader.en: I pass near a red traffic light and the stop.

reader.fr: Puis je marche jusqu'au parc avec la carte.
reader.en: Then I walk to the park with the map.

speaking.scene: Explaining the route to a city park
goals: Ask to look at the map.
Confirm the street on the right.
Locate the stop near the red traffic light.
speaking.closure: Merci, je prends la rue à droite.

see.prompt: Find written r and the /ʁ/ sound in rue, rouge, regarder, arrêt, carte, and parc.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for park before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for rue or rouge in the recorded directions.

type.prompt: Type the French direction for 'Look at the map.'

say.prompt: Tell the local person that the stop is near the red traffic light.
say.answerRef: L'arrêt est près du feu rouge.

write.prompt: Write two French directions using the map, street, and park.

lessons.title: Keep /ʁ/ in French consonant clusters
lessons.objective: Carry a French /ʁ/ immediately after a consonant in common travel and meeting words.
lessons.focus: Compare prendre /pʁ/, train /tʁ/, frère /fʁ/, and grand /gʁ/. Keep the consonant and /ʁ/ in one cluster without inserting an extra vowel.

words.fr: Je prends le train avec mon frère.
words.en: I take the train with my brother.

words.fr: Le restaurant est près de la gare.
words.en: The restaurant is near the station.

reader.fr: Je prends le train avec mon frère pour aller en ville.
reader.en: I take the train with my brother to go into town.

reader.fr: Nous cherchons un restaurant près de la gare.
reader.en: We look for a restaurant near the station.

reader.fr: Mon frère trouve un grand restaurant sur la place.
reader.en: My brother finds a big restaurant on the square.

reader.fr: Nous y entrons avant de reprendre le train.
reader.en: We go in before taking the train again.

speaking.scene: Meeting a brother for a train trip and lunch
goals: Find the restaurant near the station.
Describe the size of the restaurant.

see.prompt: Mark the consonant-plus-/ʁ/ cluster in prendre, train, frère, and grand.

recall.prompt: Recall the French word for brother before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for train or frère in the recorded travel sentence.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'I take the train with my brother.'
type.answerRef: Je prends le train avec mon frère.

say.prompt: Tell your brother that the restaurant is near the station.
say.answerRef: Le restaurant est près de la gare.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about taking the train and finding a big restaurant.
